_doc: How the Blender pipeline and scripts/assets/build-model.mjs turn one image-to-3D source into the contract model. Model-specific knobs live here; the contract stays in character.json. Validated by scripts/assets/fit.ts in tests; the Python side reads it as plain JSON.

orientation._doc: Where the source's character faces and which axis is up, in glTF axes. The pipeline rotates it to +Y up, facing +Z.

retopo._doc: Voxel remesh makes the source one manifold volume; polish then smooths the scan's lumps out of it (Taubin: iterations of a lambda pass and an inflating mu pass, which keeps the volume; keep spares the feet below feetM and within handM of the hands, blending over blendM); Quadriflow then builds quads. Face counts are quads (about twice as many triangles). Full is desktop only (phones keep lite), so it gets twice the density of phase 3 for a smooth outline.

bake._doc: Cycles CPU bakes from the source to the retopologised mesh. size is the ORM map per tier; baseColorSize and normalSize are separate because definition matters most in the close-ups (phase 6 raised them: the source base colour is 2048 px, and the camera now gets within centimetres of his face). The normal map exists only on full, where 2048 px carries the scales (see scales); the ORM stays at 1024 px, which holds the grooves' shading well enough at a quarter of the bytes. flatten pulls the baked colours towards the median body and belly tones, removing the shading the image-to-3D service baked into them.

scales._doc: The full model's skin, like the concept's: domed scales parted by narrow grooves, a 3D cell pattern in object space (no seams), coarseM wide, finer (fineM) within limbReachM of the forearms, hands, shins and feet and within faceReachM of the snout tip, blended over blendM. randomness jitters the cells, grooveWidth and dome shape them (in cell units), and they rise depthM at strength over the polished forms in the normal map. The belly (its lighter tone, found with Otsu's threshold softened over toneSpread, between the legs and the neck and within halfWidthM of the middle, fading over fadeM) gets rows of plates rowM high and widthM wide, laid like bricks, with grooveM joints; the rows curve up towards the sides (curve, per metre) and wobble by warpM over noise of warpScale, and the joints within a row are jointDepth as deep as the grooves between rows. cavity darkens the occlusion and raises the roughness in the grooves of the ORM map.

compress._doc: Applied to both tiers after assembly. Meshopt quantises the attributes and stores them with EXT_meshopt_compression, whose decoder ships inside three-stdlib. The quantisation volume is scene-wide so the contract's single skin is not split one per mesh. textures picks the container Blender bakes into per tier: the lite tier paints first, so it carries WebP and never waits on a transcoder.

rig._doc: Bone rest heads come from landmarks measured on the normalised mesh. Overrides replace a bone's measured head (metres, contract axes). influenceLimitsM caps how far (metres) from its segment a bone of each role may deform the skin, so arms resting on the body do not drag the chest. armpitMarginM lets an arm bone reach only this far inside its shoulder, since the contract has no clavicles. weightSmoothing blurs weights over neighbouring vertices so limbs bend without creases. armSeparation then keeps arm weight on the arm: below the armpit (found every stepM down from the shoulder) only the arm's own tube keeps it, above it a cut from the gap under the arm to the shoulder fades over falloffM; the build fails if raising the arms to the steepest carried pose moves the side of the body more than maxBodyMoveM.

eyes._doc: Eyeballs sit at ±x on a front ray at height y (null: measured from the head), sunk so that protrude × radius stays outside the skin.

face._doc: Front patch of the snout that carries the expression atlas. mouthY null: measured from the snout. Half extents are in metres around the mouth anchor.

mouth._doc: The T-rex jaw (character.json jaw) on this snout. The lip line runs at the face's mouth height, from corner to corner at ±halfWidth, the corners raised by smile. The jaw hinges hingeBackM behind the snout tip. The lips are cut exactly along the line; the lower lip reaches cutDepthM under it. cavityHeightM is the half height of the mouth cavity. Blade teeth (thin in and out by thickness) sit insetM behind the lip surface, rootM into the gums, raked back rakeDeg so they hide in the closed mouth. The tusks sit at a share of the half width and ride just outside the lips (clearanceM), the upper pair hanging over the lower lip, the lower pair rising over the upper lip, curling away by curl towards the tip, with growth rings; they show with the mouth shut. The gums run just inside each lip.

plates._doc: Hexagonal plates cast onto the back and tail from these bones, outward along dir (y, z). size in metres, embed is the share of the plate below the skin.

review._doc: Cycles CPU review renders committed to assets/review/phase-3.
